sv.title: EU avvisar klimatmötets slutdokument: ”Djupt besvikna”
sv.summary: Romina Pourmokhtari har lämnat COP31 Antalya 2026 – och EU har sagt nej till utkastet som tagits fram. ”Vi är djupt besvikna över det slutgiltiga utkastet”, säger EU-delegationen i ett uttalande enligt Sky News.

en.title: EU rejects climate summit's final document: "Deeply disappointed"
en.summary: Romina Pourmokhtari has left COP31 Antalya 2026 – and the EU has said no to the draft that has been produced. "We are deeply disappointed with the final draft," the EU delegation says in a statement, according to Sky News.
